_source: Comer et al. 2022, SI Table S1 -- Hubbard U (eV) used for 3d bulk/surface DFT+U. 4d and 5d metals in this dataset were treated at plain PBE (no U).
_note: MLIP checkpoints don't carry a Hubbard U term, so this isn't a knob to match -- it's provenance for what 'PBE+U' means for the literature ΔE_ads/ΔG_ads values in adsorption_energies.csv, i.e. why a DFT+U number and a plain-PBE MLIP number can disagree even when both are 'right'.

_ref_key.2: Jain et al., Phys. Rev. B 2011, 84, 045115 (Materials Project)
